description: Openly licensed pictures for a word: first the Wikimedia Commons picture of the Wikidata item the word names (found in the word's own language, so "hus" in nb finds a house), then Pixabay's photos and drawings, then Openverse's, sorted so those whose title or tags hold the word come first. Give the bare word without its article, and its language. Each has an image_url to put on a card and a credit to show with it. Look at the credit: it names the picture.

language.description: The language of the word (a code from list_languages); default "en"

query.description: The word, without its article ("hus", not "et hus")

name: find_pictures
title: Find free pictures
